title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Scorned Wilderness The Shattered Stronghold Guide
author: Jacob Fox
description:
Welcome to The Shattered Stronghold, the third section of the Scorned Wilderness in RuneScape: Dragonwilds!

This section starts off relatively straightforward, with several basic mobs and a simple Anima puzzle. Unlike the previous sections, you'll only need to power one Anima pylon to progress.

First, you'll need to obtain an Air Anima charge, which is guarded by several rats. Charge yourself with Air Anima and pass through the Air Anima door.

Inside you'll find several Air-type mobs, an Anima Orb dispenser, and a gate lever. Flip the lever first so you can use this entrance as an easier route from now on. Then defeat the mobs to charge yourself with enough Air Anima to activate the Orb dispenser.

Take the Anima Orb back to the pylon and place it. Once you do, you'll discover that this is actually a Fire Anima pylon.

Next, head behind the fallen tower and defeat the rats guarding the Earth Anima. Charge yourself with Earth Anima, then return to the staircase leading toward the Air Anima door. This time, take the opposite path to reach the room containing the Fire Anima.

Defeat the mobs inside and flip the second lever so you can use this route as an easier entrance from now on. Charge yourself with Fire Anima and return to the pylon to power it.

Once the Fire Anima pylon is fully charged, a bridge will spawn and open the path to the second half of The Shattered Stronghold.

The next section features another Level 9 Black Dragon, several Garou Hunters, and Ruby Vines. Take out everything in your way and the next checkpoint is just up the path behind the enemies.

The Scorned Wilderness is made up of Level 8 areas, with Level 9 boss mobs sprinkled throughout. If you're preparing to explore the region, it's recommended that you first farm Rune and Luminite Ore to craft Rune gear. From there, you can farm Magic Trees and Vis to work toward higher-level armor and weapons.

That said, I went through the Scorned Wilderness wearing a full set of Obsidian armor and didn't have too many issues, so you don't necessarily need the highest-level gear to start exploring.

This is the third of four detailed guides covering each section of the Scorned Wilderness. Once all four sections are covered, I'll combine them into one complete Scorned Wilderness guide.

Don't forget to subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, gameplay, updates, and everything happening in Ashenfall!
